properties.description: The convention rides the tool and stays bounded: the tools whose skills carry a non-inferable rule have that one sentence in their served description (checked against a named list, so adding a tool without considering it is caught); no description exceeds the sentence budget, because the cost of this is context paid on every session; and the toolsnap goldens still match, so the addition is a deliberate surface change rather than drift. Enforced in skill_lint alongside the existing served-tool-name checks. PLANNED.
properties.name: The convention rides the tool, and stays inside its budget
